name: FOFFOS annual grant (ocean and coastal conservation and restoration)

funder.name: Ferris Olson Family Foundation for Ocean Stewardship (FOFFOS)

summary: Annual one-year grants (past requests ranged from under $10,000 to $50,000) for action-oriented ocean and coastal conservation, ecosystem restoration and community stewardship projects led by US 501(c)(3) organisations. Apply by email or post.

amount.note: Past requests ranged from under $10,000 to $50,000.
